text:
The resistor-load CS stage meets every spec except swing, and swing barely responds to any parameter. The measured swing seems to be set by how gain changes with output level. With a pure resistor load, the NMOS current and gm fall to zero as the output rises toward VDD, so the gain collapses at the top of the range. I'm adding a PMOS current source in parallel with RD so the NMOS always carries at least Ip. That keeps gm, and so gain, up near the top rail. The same total current and gm keep gain and GBW where they were.

The PMOS gate is biased from a 3 MΩ divider (about 0.6 µA). That costs less than a second mirror branch and leaves budget to raise I to about 66 µA.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Swing is set by gain collapse near VDD (NMOS current goes to zero). A parallel PMOS current source keeps NMOS gm up across the output range. A cheap 3 MΩ divider biases it, leaving power to raise I and keep GBW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":     (65e-6, 55e-6, 66.5e-6),   # total NMOS current
    "fp":    (0.33, 0.15, 0.5),         # fraction of I supplied by the PMOS current source
    "RD":    (13.3e3, 10e3, 18e3),
    "gmidp": (14, 8, 20),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = 0.75
    I, RD, Ln = p["I"], p["RD"], p["Ln"]
    Ip = p["fp"] * I
    IR = I - Ip
    vout = VDD - IR * RD

    # NMOS: W such that Id(Vgs=vin, Vds=vout) = I
    Wn = 10.0
    for _ in range(4):
        on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
        Wn = max(0.42, Wn * I / on["Id"])
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
    rn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout)

    # PMOS current source supplying Ip
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=max(VDD - vout, 0.1))
    vsg = mp.vgs
    Rtot = 3e6
    R1 = Rtot * vsg / VDD          # vdd -> pg
    R2 = Rtot - R1                 # pg -> vss

    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wn, 3), Ln)
    n.R("RD", "vdd", "vout", RD)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RB1", "vdd", "pg", R1)
    n.R("RB2", "pg", "vss", R2)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    cout = rn.cdd + rn.cgd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    G = 1.0 / RD + on["gds"] + mp.gds
    A = on["gm"] / G
    f3 = G / (2 * PI * (cl + cout))
    power = VDD * (I + iref + VDD / Rtot)
    swing = VDD - mp.vdsat - on["vdsat"] - 0.1

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": A * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
